name: Allan Lichtman
bio: Allan Jay Lichtman is an American historian who has taught at American University in Washington DC since 1973. He is best known for creating the Keys to the White House with Soviet seismologist Vladimir Keilis-Borok in 1981.
place: Brooklyn, New York City, New York, U.S.
